findings.summary: Focused on the review #40 P1 allegation only: it does not match the supplied current source. Both the callback gate and the user warning in TelegramJobIngress.control() use the post-cancel authoritative read, not the pre-read snapshot: `current=self.queue.status(...)` then `if cancelled and current['attempts']>0 and self.cancel_callback is not None:self.cancel_callback(job_id)` and `if current['attempts']>0:text+=' Уже начатый внешний вызов мог продолжиться.'` (ingress.py:163-167). The two supplied counterexamples correspond exactly to the two race windows: test_cancel_warning_uses_actual_attempts_if_worker_claims_after_status_read claims inside the status() read (after the snapshot value is captured but before it is returned to control()), and test_cancel_warning_when_claim_occurs_strictly_before_cancel_update claims strictly before the real cancel UPDATE (jobs.py:186), asserting attempts==1 and the exact warning text; both operate on real PostgreSQL transitions with no publication/ACK bypass, and the test file hash is supplied. Because both the callback and warning derive from post-cancel attempts, a claim after the status snapshot or strictly before the cancel UPDATE is covered by the same code path; no executable failure of the alleged defect exists in the supplied code. No P0/P1 findings in this focused scope; per the stated rule the verdict is SHIP_OK for this focused resolution only, with other scope limitations noted separately.
